text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an All-Way Stop Control be installed at the intersection of Brimorton Drive and Dolly Varden Boulevard as the existing conditions meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing the northbound and southbound approaches on Dolly Varden Boulevard at this four-way intersection.
Scarborough Community Council deferred consideration of the item until the July 4, 2018 meeting.
